name: Sri Aadhi Varahi Amman Shrine
description: Presiding deity Sri Aadhi Varahi, with idols of all Sapta Matrikas. Also enshrined here (as pictures and yantras, idols not yet installed) are Sri Maha Kaali, Sri Maha Pratyangira, Sri Aadhi Muneeswaran, Sri Aadhi Karuppanasamy and Sri Aadhi Veerabadhran.

name: Sri Uchishta Maha Ganapathy Shrine
description: Shrine of Sri Uchishta Maha Ganapathy, a distinctive form of Ganesha, set atop a raised platform reached by five steps, open-sided with a pillared roof structure above.

name: Sri Maha Rudra Bhairavar Shrine
description: Presiding deity Sri Maha Rudra Bhairavar. On a platform in front, under the same roof, are: Sri Valampuri Vinayagar, Sri Maha Rudra Bhairavar (aimpon, five-metal alloy), and Sri Anjaneya Swamy.

name: Sri Narmadeshwarar Shrine
description: Shrine of Sri Narmadeswarar, a Baana Linga (self-manifested) from the Narmada River. Devotees can perform abhishekam here at any time. Bhasma Aarti is conducted on Maha Shivaratri, a ritual otherwise associated with Ujjain's Mahakaleshwar Temple.
